title: Picking another Pricing Matrix moves the category at once
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on the General Matrix.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, which prices no category.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Pick matrix A in the Pricing Matrix picker.
  4. Open Settings › Categories.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed on the General Matrix.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page shows the General Matrix's grid.

Step 3:

  • The page shows matrix A's grid.
  • A message reads category A's name, "now uses" and matrix A's name, with "Parts already on work orders keep their prices."

Step 4:

  • Category A's Pricing Matrix cell reads matrix A.
